title: Lecture tonight in Connecticut
content: With Daniel Ksepka, Curator of Science at the Bruce Museum,and expert onPelagornis, which I illustrated for Scientific AmericanThanks to everyone who attended the sold-out workshop last night at the Bruce Museum in Greenwich, Connecticut. Tonight at 7:00pm I'll be back to give an illustrated lecture called "How I Paint Dinosaurs: Art, Science, and Imagination."Come at 6:30 for the reception, and stay afterward for the book signing.Reservations required.
